verdict.rationale: Granola documents pre-meeting briefs, prepared overnight, that show open threads, relevant context and agenda points when you open the note as you join. This directly covers the 'brief of open threads before the call' half of the story. The docs never say the brief surfaces or links past meetings with the same attendees; 'relevant context' and calendar 'meeting context' only imply it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that prior meetings with the same participants are surfaced before the call, independent or hands-on corroboration of brief quality.

support.subject: As a founder, I walk into each meeting prepped — the tool surfaces past meetings with the same people and a brief of open threads before the call

citations.quote: Granola preps you for your meetings overnight. Open your note as you join and you'll see a short brief with open threads, relevant context, and agenda points
